senses.gloss:
वाढ वाढ (cf. वहल and बहु),
 I. adj., comparat. साधीयंस्, superl. साधिष्ठ.
 1. Hard, firm; साधीयंस्, firmest, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 19.
 2. Much.
 II. acc. sing. ढम्, adv.
 1. Much, excessively, Śiś. 9, 77.
 2. Indeed, truly, Rām. 3, 51, 6; Śiś. 9, 51.
 3. Well, very well, Pañc. 24, 11; yes, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 9.
